title: CPF Module Schema: azure-prdsvc-terraform-recoveryservicesvault
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-recoveryservicesvault'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

application_consistent_snapshot_frequenc.description: (Optional) Frequency in minutes for application-consistent snapshots.

cmk_key_name.description: (optional) Key name to be used (max 127 chars)

cmk_rotation_policy.type: object({ notify_before_expiry = string time_before_expiry = string time_after_creation = optional(string, null) expire_after = string })
cmk_rotation_policy.description: (Optional) A rotation policy block as defined below object({ notify_before_expiry = "(Optional) Expire a Key Vault Key after given duration as an ISO 8601 duration." time_before_expiry = "(Optional) Rotate automatically at a duration before expiry as an ISO 8601 duration." time_after_creation = "(Optional) Rotate automatically at a duration before expiry as an ISO 8601 duration." expire_after = "(Optional) Expire a Key Vault Key after given duration as an ISO 8601 duration." })

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

create_file_backup_policy.description: (Optional) Set to true to enable file backup policy, false otherwise.

create_rsv.description: (Required) Whether to Create RSV When RSV is already exists

create_site_recovery_replicated_vm.description: (Optional) Flag to create the Azure Site Recovery replicated VM

create_vm_backup_policy.description: (Optional) Set to true to enable VM backup policy, false otherwise.

cross_region_restore_enabled.description: (Optional) Cross region restore is a feature that allows you to restore data from a Recovery Services Vault in one region to a Recovery Services Vault in another region.

cross_subscription_restore_state.description: (Optional) State for cross subscription restore. Allowed values: Enabled, Disabled. Default is Disabled.

customer_managed_key.type: object({ key_vault_id = string infrastructure_encryption_enabled = bool expiration_date = string identity_id = optional(string) identity_principal_id = optional(string) use_system_assigned_identity = optional(bool, false) })
customer_managed_key.description: (Required) An customer_managed_key block as defined below object({ key_vault_id = "(Required) The resource ID of the Key Vault where the Key Vault Key resides." infrastructure_encryption_enabled = "(Required) Used to specify whether enable Infrastructure Encryption (Double Encryption). Changing this forces a new resource to be created." expiration_date = "(Required) Expiration UTC datetime (Y-m-d'T'H:M:S'Z')." identity_id = "(Optional) The resource ID of the User Assigned Identity that has access to the key. To be used if `use_system_assigned_identity` is set to `false`" identity_principal_id = "(Optional) The principal ID of the User Assigned Identity that has access to the key. To be used if `use_system_assigned_identity` is set to `false`" use_system_assigned_identity = "(Optional) Indicate that system assigned identity should be used for CMK or not. Defaults to `false`" })

data_disks.type: list(object({ disk_id = string staging_storage_account_id = string target_disk_type = string target_replica_disk_type = string target_disk_encryption_set_id = string }))
data_disks.description: (Optional) List of data disk configurations for replication

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

existing_rsv.description: (Optional) An existing_Recovery Service Vaults block supports the following: existing_rsv_name = "(Optional) The name of the existing Recovery Service Vaults." existing_rsv_rg = "(Optional) The name of the existing Resource Group in which the Recovery Service Vaults exists."

fabric_secondary_name.description: (Optional) Name of the secondary recovery fabric

fileshareretention_daily_count.description: (Optional) Number of daily backups to retain

fileshareretention_monthly_count.description: (Optional) Number of monthly backups to retain

fileshareretention_weekly_count.description: (Optional) Number of weekly backups to retain

fileshareretention_yearly_count.description: (Optional) Number of yearly backups to retain

identity.description: (Optional) An identity block as defined below object({ type = "(Required) Specifies the type of Managed Service Identity that should be configured on this Recovery Services Vault. Possible values are `SystemAssigned`, `UserAssigned`, `SystemAssigned, UserAssigned` (to enable both)." identity_ids = "(Optional) Specifies a list of User Assigned Managed Identity IDs to be assigned to this App Configuration. This is required when `type` is set to `UserAssigned` or `SystemAssigned, UserAssigned`." })

immutability.description: (Optional) Immutability Settings of vault, possible values include: Locked, Unlocked and Disabled.

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

instant_restore_resource_group_prefix.description: (Required) Prefix for instant restore resource group

instant_restore_resource_group_suffix.description: (Optional) Suffix for instant restore resource group

instant_restore_retention_days.description: (Optional) Specifies the instant restore retention range in days

key_vault_tags.description: (Optional) Key Vault related tags to be set on key vault child resources.

monitoring.type: object({ alerts_for_all_job_failures_enabled = optional(bool, true) alerts_for_critical_operation_failures_enabled = optional(bool, true) })
monitoring.description: (Optional) A monitoring block as defined below. object({ alerts_for_all_job_failures_enabled = "(Optional) Enabling/Disabling built-in Azure Monitor alerts for security scenarios and job failure scenarios. Defaults to `true`." alerts_for_critical_operation_failures_enabled = "(Optional) Enabling/Disabling alerts from the older (classic alerts) solution. Defaults to `true`." })

network_mapping_name.description: (Optional) The name of the network mapping for Azure Site Recovery.

os_disk_id.description: (Optional) The ID of the OS disk.

primary_location.description: (Optional) The primary location for the Azure resources.

protection_container_secondary_name.description: (Optional) Name of the secondary protection container

recovery_point_retention_in_minutes.description: (Optional) The retention period for recovery points in minutes.

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

resource_group_name_secondary.description: (Optional) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

retention_daily_count.description: (Optional) Number of daily backups to retain

retention_monthly_count.description: (Optional) Number of monthly backups to retain

retention_weekly_count.description: (Optional) Number of weekly backups to retain

retention_yearly_count.description: (Optional) Number of yearly backups to retain

rsv_subnet_id.description: (Optional) The ID of the subnet for the Recovery Services Vault.

sku.description: (Required) The SKU for the Recovery Services Vault.

staging_storage_account_id.description: (Optional) ID of the staging storage account

storage_account_id.description: (Optional) The ID of the storage account.

storage_mode_type.description: (Optional) The storage type of the Recovery Services Vault.

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

target_disk_type.description: (Optional) The type of the target disk.

target_encryption_set_id.description: (Optional) The ID of the target disk encryption set.

target_replica_disk_type.description: (Optional) The type of the target replica disk.

fileshare_policy_id.description: The ID of the FileShare Backup Policy

fileshare_policy_name.description: The ID of the FileShare Backup Policy

id.description: The ID of the Recovery Service vault.

name.description: The Name of the Recovery Service Vault.

vm_policy_id.description: The ID of the VM Backup Policy

vm_policy_name.description: The ID of the VM Backup Policy

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Recoveryservicesvault' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
